definitions.explanation: To form letters, characters, or symbols on a surface. Used for writing by hand, typing, or composing text. Covers both the physical act of writing and the creative act of composing.
Can also mean to draw or paint pictures, though {描|えが}く/{描|か}く is more specific for artistic drawing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}く。
⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}きました。
⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}いて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{書|か}けます⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}いている。⟦{一年|いちねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{続|つづ}けている→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: I write in my diary every day. I've kept it up for a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}いて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: The child is drawing a picture.
I drew a picture of a cat.
I've liked drawing since I was little. Now I draw for work.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{書|か}く (write X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {書|か}いている = 'is writing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}く (write a letter)
・{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}く (write one's name)
・{日記|にっき}を{書|か}く (write a diary)
・{書|か}き{方|かた} (way of writing)

Irregular te-form: {書|か}いて (not {書|か}きて). Also used for drawing: {絵|え}を{書|か}く.
